feed.title: NPR Topics: Business
feed.subtitle: Find the latest business news with reports on Wall Street, interest rates, banking, companies, and U.S. and world financial markets. Subscribe to the Business Story of the Day podcast.

entry.title: The Trump administration weakens fuel efficiency standards for new cars
entry.summary: The Trump administration says easing these standards will make cars more affordable. Critics say it's not so simple and could be costly for the environment.

entry.title: What we know about the suspected U.K. terror plot. And, why the Gulf remains in limbo
entry.summary: What we know — and still don't — about the suspected terror plot near a U.K. air base. Trump rejects Iran's offer to pause fighting. And CNN prepares for new owners with ties to Trump.

entry.title: Oura puts a ring on Wall Street with one of this year's biggest IPOs
entry.summary: The leading smart ring manufacturer is betting its trove of health data will be a hit with Wall Street.

entry.title: Everyone is racing to create an AI device. Meta thinks it has one
entry.summary: Tech companies are betting that people will connect with AI using something other than smartphones. Meta is going all-in on glasses, after launching its new AI agent Muse.

entry.title: Aga's restaurant in Houston is number one in the world for Uber Eats deliveries
entry.summary: In Houston, Aga's Indian-Pakistani restaurant serves around 4,000 meals a day and according to Uber Eats, it has the most takeout orders in the world on the their platform.

entry.title: Why this Pokémon set is dropping in value
entry.summary: How does one price a cemetery plot? Are they using dynamic pricing to figure it out? We tackle that question and many more in this week's Indicator newsletter.

entry.title: American farmers are hurting -- and worried about their futures
entry.summary: Farmers who grow soybeans, corn, cotton and other crops are facing another year of losses as soaring fuel and fertilizer costs offset higher revenues.

entry.title: The U.S. Strategic Petroleum Reserve is low. Here's why you should care
entry.summary: The U.S. has tapped into its strategic oil reserve to help drive down rising gasoline prices in the wake of the war with Iran. Can oil from Venezuela help fill it back up?

entry.title: How stores choose what to put on their shelves — like, say, Planet Money's board game
entry.summary: The most coveted real estate in business might just be the choicest shelf space of national big box retail. We go inside the room and the process of how stores choose what you can and can't buy.

entry.title: Mortgage rates have just surpassed 7% for the first time in well over a year
entry.summary: Rates have climbed more than a full percentage point since the U.S. war against Iran started.
